import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [3, 8, 5, 12, 7],
    "b": [2, 5, 6, 1, 4]
})

# Define callback - receives one row at a time
def check_sum(row):
    return "hi" if row["a"] + row["b"] > 10 else "lo"

# Apply to each row using map_rows
result = df.with_columns(
    pl.struct("a", "b").map_rows(check_sum).alias("result")
)

print(result)
